Input group

Source: R/tier2-input-group.R
shad_input_group.Rd

A bordered shell that wraps a shad_input() or shad_textarea() together with leading/trailing addons (icons, prefixes, buttons) or block toolbars. The shell owns the border, shadow, and focus/invalid ring; the wrapped control drops its own chrome so the group reads as one field. The control keeps its native Shiny binding — read it with input$<inputId> as usual.

Usage

shad_input_group(..., block = FALSE, invalid = FALSE, class = NULL)

shad_input_group_addon(
  ...,
  align = c("inline-start", "inline-end", "block-start", "block-end"),
  class = NULL
)

shad_input_group_text(..., class = NULL)

shad_input_group_button(label = NULL, ..., variant = "ghost", class = NULL)

Arguments

...

Addons (shad_input_group_addon()) and the wrapped control, in render order, and/or named HTML attributes.

block

If TRUE, stretch to full width (default is content width).

invalid

If TRUE, paint the destructive border/ring (mirror the wrapped control's invalid).

class

Extra CSS classes.

align

Addon placement: "inline-start", "inline-end", "block-start", or "block-end". Block addons take their own full-width row (toolbar strips).

label

Button label (first positional, for convenience).

variant

Button variant (defaults to "ghost" to sit quietly in the field).

Value

An input-group tag.

See also

shad_input(), shad_textarea(), shad_input_group_addon()

Other shadshiny tier-2 components: shad_calendar(), shad_checkbox(), shad_combobox(), shad_date_picker(), shad_date_presets(), shad_form_field(), shad_input(), shad_input_otp(), shad_native_select(), shad_radio_group(), shad_select(), shad_slider(), shad_switch(), shad_textarea(), shad_toggle(), shad_toggle_group()

Examples

shad_input_group(
  shad_input_group_addon(shad_icon("search"), align = "inline-start"),
  shad_input("q", placeholder = "Search..."),
  block = TRUE
)
#> <div class="shad-input-group shad-input-group--block" role="group">
#>   <span class="shad-input-group__addon" data-align="inline-start"><svg class="shad-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="8"/><path d="m21 21-4.3-4.3"/></svg></span>
#>   <input id="q" class="shad-input" type="text" placeholder="Search..."/>
#> </div>
